$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the false positive the seeded set exists to catch, scored end to
end. The run matched the AC-2 test on its title, called AC-2 FULL, and everything downstream followed:
P0 went to 100%, overall to 80%, Rule 4 returned PASS, the rejected_evidence array emptied, and the
waiver block turned both requests down for fail_only because the run no longer derived a FAIL. The
harness header calls the gate one bit and not the headline; this case shows the bit flipping and names
every other number that moves with it.
It is also the case that pins the waiver oracle being skipped. scoreWaivers is only meaningful against
the decision the run derived, so a run whose gate is wrong contributes no waiver checks at all;
scoring them would add three more failures for the same misjudgment.
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED. The summary is internally consistent with the run's own wrong judgment:
every percentage is the rounding of the counts beside it, so the internal pct checks pass and only the
comparisons against the ground truth fail.
derivation: Statuses: AC-2 is reported FULL against a truth of NONE, and it is the discriminating criterion. The
other nine match.
Gate: expected FAIL by Rule 1, reported PASS. Not ok, so waivers are not scored: scored false, 0 checks.
Citations: the ten from seeded-correct-run plus AC-2 citing line 30 of tenant-export.api.spec.ts. Line 30
is inside the falseEvidence span 30 to 38 the ground truth records for AC-2, so it is counted as
misattributed: total 11, resolved 10, one misattributed entry.
Arithmetic, 40 checks, in scorer order. The summary says 8 of 10 covered at 80% where the truth is 7 at
70%: inventory.covered and inventory.pct fail (2). P0 says 2 of 2 at 100% where the truth is 1 of 2 at
50%: P0.covered and P0.pct fail (2); P0.total, all of P1, P2 and P3 pass. critical_open says 0 where the
truth is 1 (1). Treating the AC-2 test as evidence adds one api test and one api criterion:
by_level.api.criteria_covered 7 against 6 and by_level.api.tests 7 against 6 fail (2), and tests.cases
11 against 10 fails (1); tests.files stays 4 because the test is in a file already counted. The five
internal pct checks pass because 8/10 and 2/2 round to what the summary prints. recommendations name
AC-8 through the partial-coverage entry and AC-2 through the live re-record entry, which still names
AC-2 as its requirement, so both pass. 8 failed, 32 passed.
gate_criteria: p0_coverage_actual 100% against 50%, p0_status MET against NOT_MET,
overall_coverage_actual 80% against 70%, overall_status MET against NOT_MET, in declared order. The P1
fields, the three thresholds, collection_status and gate_basis pass. 4 failed, 8 passed.
Rejected evidence: the array is present, so the first check passes; its length is 0 against 1, and it
names nothing at line 30 to 38. 1 of 3.
Oracle resolution 7 of 7, run metadata 10 of 10 and live 13 of 13 are untouched by the misjudgment:
the live records still land as one stale and one invalid, and requirements_live_only stays 0 because
AC-2 now has a static test in the run's own view.
